critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /matches returns 200 by default; consider 201 for resource creation semantics (minor, non-blocking).

match.tsx useFocusEffect (not useEffect) checks matchId - together with summary.handleEnd's flow of setState BEFORE router.replace this now works because focus effect only runs on focus transitions; the previous race is properly resolved.

context/match.tsx logSub reads existing events count via GET then does subsSoFar = existing.filter + 1 (the newly-posted event may or may not be in 'existing' depending on network timing since existing is fetched BEFORE the POST). This is safe for the current test but is technically eventual-consistent; consider using a local counter to avoid off-by-one in flaky networks.
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own matches/events per test with unique UUIDs; no cleanup needed. Frontend E2E creates disposable matches too.
